description:
Somos a Apollo.exe, uma equipe movida pela paixão por tecnologia, ciência e inovação.

Inspirados pela coragem dos guerreiros espartanos e pelo espírito explorador das missões Apollo, acreditamos que grandes conquistas começam com ideias ousadas e determinação para transformá-las em realidade.

Nossa missão é unir criatividade, engenharia de software e pensamento estratégico para desenvolver soluções inteligentes que ultrapassem os limites do convencional.
summary: GeoSafra is a web-based decision-support tool that helps farmers compare crop rotation strategies using NASA Earth observations, local field information, and their own priorities. Farmers map a field, describe its soil and crop history, and choose goals such as conserving water, reducing erosion, improving soil health, or diversifying income. GeoSafra combines historical climate and satellite information with transparent agronomic rules to compare the current rotation with alternatives, highlight climate risks, and explore planting windows. An AI-assisted explanation layer translates the analysis into accessible insights, while keeping scores grounded in explicit rules and data. By making complex information easier to understand, GeoSafra helps growers explore more resilient choices for their next season. Results show data gaps and limitations and support discussion with local agronomists.
details:
GeoSafra turns NASA Earth observations into accessible information to help farmers explore crop rotation strategies suited to their fields, practical constraints, and priorities.

HOW IT WORKS

Farmers locate and map their field, enter crop history and local soil information, and identify priorities such as conserving water, reducing erosion, improving organic matter, fixing nitrogen, producing forage, or diversifying income.

The platform combines these inputs with historical climate and satellite information. NASA POWER weather data support the analysis of water balance, reference evapotranspiration, dry spells, temperature extremes, and planting windows. SRTM elevation data inform terrain and erosion indicators, while HLS and MODIS vegetation observations provide additional environmental context.

An agronomic rules engine filters unsuitable crops and compares the current rotation with alternative strategies. Scores consider water availability, soil structure, nitrogen, erosion, organic matter, pest cycles, forage, income, market fit, and climate resilience. Farmer priorities influence the relative importance of these criteria.

AI-GENERATED INSIGHTS

An AI-assisted explanation layer translates analytical results into clear language, helping producers understand the benefits, trade-offs, and risks of each alternative. Numerical scores are calculated from explicit rules and data; AI helps communicate their meaning.

BENEFITS AND INTENDED IMPACT

GeoSafra aims to make complex Earth-observation information useful for everyday agricultural planning. By presenting alternatives and explaining their differences, the platform supports informed discussions about crop diversification, soil protection, water management, and adaptation to climate variability.

The interface is available in Portuguese and English, and users can explore the platform without creating an account.

TECHNOLOGY AND CREATIVITY

GeoSafra was developed using Laravel and PHP for the web application, and Python for data processing and analytical services. The platform combines interactive field mapping, NASA Earth observations, an agronomic rules engine, and an AI-assisted explanation layer.

Its creative contribution is connecting observations from space with local field information and farmer priorities. Instead of presenting isolated environmental indicators, GeoSafra brings them into a practical workflow where growers can compare crop rotations, understand trade-offs, and explore alternatives through clear explanations.

DESIGN CONSIDERATIONS AND LIMITATIONS

We considered climate variability, soil conditions, crop history, equipment availability, market suitability, and competing farmer priorities. We also considered differences in spatial resolution, missing observations, and uncertainty.

Regional climate grids and satellite pixels do not replace local measurements. GeoSafra communicates data gaps and limitations, and its scenarios explore changes to historical conditions rather than predicting future weather. Results support decision-making and should be reviewed alongside farmer experience and local agronomic advice.

AI tools also assisted development, writing, visual assets, and synthesized narration in project materials. Dataset credits and methodological details are documented at:
https://geosafra.softrix.com.br/metodologia
